translations.web: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
translations.bsb: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
translations.kjv: Do ye ➔ not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
translations.asv: Or know ye not that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world is judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
